narrative.details:
"Rezlack, when an opportunity come's knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.

This orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!

There are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.

Go harvest some and bring them back to me!
narrative.objectives: Bring 5 Charged Thunder Lizard Organs to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hey, thanks pal! You've been a really big help to me here and I appreciate it.Here's to hoping I can get this all charged up using these organs. I bet it'll make those no good harpies think twice about attacking my caravan again. I sure hope this works.Either way you've done your side of the deal. Take this for your trouble.
narrative.requestItemsText: It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder.Well, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean.Trust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 11, 1,750 XP in all.
